**Exact GPU model / board manufacturer / board revision**

**PCI and subsystem IDs**

**macOS / architecture / driver versions**

**RGB controller / protocol documentation, if known**
Link public source references and their licenses. Do not suggest guessing addresses or enabling broad vendor matches.

**Observed behavior**
Describe only tests actually performed. A detected model or successful command is not proof of visible lighting.

**Private report submitted?**
Optionally include the receipt ID, not the full private payload.
